`𝕎 k / p` and `k`.

  intro r
  refine ⟨teichmuller p r, ?_⟩

lemma adj_of_mem_walk_support {G : SimpleGraph V} {u v : V} (p : G.Walk u v) (hp : ¬p.Nil) {x : V}
    (hx : x ∈ p.support) : ∃ y ∈ p.support, G.Adj x y := by
  induction p with
  | nil =>
      exact (hp Walk.Nil.nil).elim
  | @cons u v w h p ih =>
      cases List.mem_cons.mp hx with
      | inl hxu =>
          subst hxu
          refine ⟨v, ?_, h⟩
          simpa using ((Walk.cons h p).mem_support_iff).2 (Or.inr p.start_mem_support)
      | inr hxp =>
          cases Decidable.em p.Nil with
          | inl hnil =>
              have hs : p.support = [v] := (Walk.nil_iff_support_eq).1 hnil
              have hxv : x = v := by simpa [hs] using hxp
              subst hxv
              exact ⟨u, (Walk.cons h p).start_mem_support, G.adj_symm h⟩
          | inr hnotnil =>
              obtain ⟨y, hy_mem, hy_adj⟩ := ih hnotnil hxp
              refine ⟨y, ?_, hy_adj⟩
              simpa [Walk.support_cons] using (List.mem_cons_of_mem u hy_mem)

    HasDetPlusMinusOne Γ ↔ ∀ {g}, g ∈ Γ → |g.det.val| = 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    intro g hg
    exact h.abs_det hg
  · intro h
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    intro g hg
    -- from `|g.det.val| = 1` we get `g.det.val = 1 ∨ g.det.val = -1`, hence `g.det = 1 ∨ g.det = -1`
    have habs : |g.det.val| = 1 := h hg
    have : g.det.val = 1 ∨ g.det.val = -1 := by
      simpa [abs_eq (show (0 : R) ≤ (1 : R) from zero_le_one)] using habs
    rcases this with hdet | hdet
    · left
      exact Units.ext (by simpa using hdet)
    · right
      exact Units.ext (by simpa using hdet)
